name: code-viewer
title: Code Viewer
description: A file's code to read, from the code block: coloured, its lines numbered, folding by indentation in any language, wrapped or not (the app's to keep), JSON formatted or as written, its lines' look the app's (e.g. an edit's changes), and a find bar of its own: Ctrl+F or Cmd+F while the focus is in it, Enter and Shift+Enter to the next and previous match, :120 to line 120, its matches marked in the coloured code: CSS highlights of the lines in sight, so a keystroke renders no line again (5 ms, not 70, for a term in every line of 3,500), marks where the browser has none. Embedded (variant="embedded"), it is a viewer's, as the browser's code pages: in a ViewerFrame of its own, borderless to its edges as a diff is, its tools (format, find, copy) in the frame's toolbar, Wrap, its language and length in the status bar.
